consumer: The door's NPC dialogue gate condition asking 'is the id_card on the player's body right now?'
scope: On-person only: items worn or carried on the player's body, NOT nearby/reachable crafting inventory
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — completes a find-item mission via u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(), whose reach spans nearby reachable/vehicle items, not just the body
divergence: Player carries nothing but the id_card lies on an adjacent floor tile (within crafting reach); crafting_inventory().has_amount reports true, so the gate falsely says it's carried, whereas an on-person check returns false
